import sys

def str_to_int_arr(s):
    s_arr = s.split()
    return [int(x) for x in s_arr]

class Cutting:
    def check_sub(self, a_arr, split_ind):
        n_even = 0
        n_odd = 0
        for i in range(split_ind + 1):
            el = a_arr[i]
            if el % 2 == 0:
                n_even += 1
            else:
                n_odd += 1
        return n_even == n_odd

    def get_min_avail_ind(self, a_arr, n_coins, cut_used):
        min_ind = -1
        min_cost = n_coins + 1
        for i in range(1, len(a_arr) - 1):
            cost = abs(a_arr[i] - a_arr[i + 1])
            if cost < min_cost:
                if self.check_sub(a_arr, i):
                    if i not in cut_used:
                        min_cost = cost
                        min_ind = i
        return min_ind

    def get_max_cuts(self, n, b, a_arr):
        n_coins = b
        n_cuts = 0
        cut_used = {}
        while n_coins > 0:
            ind = self.get_min_avail_ind(a_arr, n_coins, cut_used)
            if ind > -1:
                cut_used[ind] = True
                cost = abs(a_arr[ind] - a_arr[ind + 1])
                n_coins -= cost
                n_cuts += 1
            else:
                break
        return n_cuts

def main():
    nb_line = sys.stdin.readline()
    a_line = sys.stdin.readline()
    nb_arr = str_to_int_arr(nb_line)
    a_arr = str_to_int_arr(a_line)
    cut = Cutting()
    n = nb_arr[0]
    b = nb_arr[1]
    max_c = cut.get_max_cuts(n, b, a_arr)
    sys.stdout.write(str(max_c) + '\n')
    sys.stdout.flush()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
